decisions.statement: A folder the deploy owns is marked as such and weighed no further.
A folder ESOUI knows nothing about is marked as unmatched.
A version is compared with the space inside that version collapsed.
An installed addon stating no version counts as out of date.
The first ESOUI entry claiming a folder keeps that folder.
Only an out-of-date folder is picked up unless the caller forces the rest.
A download is fetched once however many folders that download has.

definition: what each installed addon folder is, weighed against what ESOUI offers
